title: Gated pipeline
alt: Six gate stages run in order; a failing stage rejects the change before an Exit-0 receipt is signed.
text: Gate stages, in order: 1. Prefetch & Lockfiles (.standards.yaml, .standards.lock), 2. HISS Invariant Scan (ratchet against the debt baseline), 3. Security & SCA Scan (govulncheck, gosec), 4. Flavor Conformance (flavor audit), 5. Race-Detector Tests (go test -race in a worktree), 6. Ed25519 Exit-0 Receipt (signs the stage output).
Boxes: Candidate commit (praetorctl gate run), Signing key (PRAETOR_RECEIPT_KEY or key file), Rejected (exit 1, stage named), .standards-receipt.json (Exit-0 receipt).
Candidate commit → 1. Prefetch & Lockfiles (clean tree) → 2. HISS Invariant Scan → 3. Security & SCA Scan → 4. Flavor Conformance → 5. Race-Detector Tests → 6. Ed25519 Exit-0 Receipt.
2. HISS Invariant Scan → Rejected (HISS findings or missing scanner).
3. Security & SCA Scan → Rejected (vulnerabilities or missing scanner).
4. Flavor Conformance → Rejected (flavor score below the bar or missing template).
6. Ed25519 Exit-0 Receipt → Rejected (no signing key).

Scenario 1, clean run: Every stage passes and the receipt is signed. The tree matches HEAD. Lockfiles found; modules verified. No HISS violation beyond the baseline. govulncheck and gosec pass. Flavor conformance holds. Race-detector tests pass. LoadSigningKey returns the Ed25519 key. The stage output is signed for this commit.
Scenario 2, HISS violation: A new violation fails stage 2; no later stage runs. The tree matches HEAD. Stage 1 passes. The ratchet finds a violation beyond the baseline; the gate exits 1.

Scenario 3, dry run: gate run --dry-run runs the read-only checks only. The tree may differ from HEAD. Lockfiles checked; module download skipped. The HISS scan runs. Security scan skipped. Flavor conformance runs. Race-detector tests skipped. No receipt is minted.
Scenario 4, lockfile mismatch: A checksum mismatch fails stage 1; no later stage runs. VerifyLockfiles finds a checksum that does not match .standards.lock; the gate exits 1.

Scenario 5, security finding: A vulnerability fails stage 3; no later stage runs. The tree matches HEAD. Lockfiles verified. No HISS violation beyond the baseline. govulncheck or gosec reports a vulnerability, or the scanner itself is missing; the gate exits 1.
(Shortened to 2500 characters; docs/figures/gating-pipeline.ts holds the full content.)
